_about: ONE home for what the AI reviewer does with each kind of paper (order 13, K1b). The code reads only this file (kind_review_table.py): the gate, the equipment rule, the checklist, the page split and the CRS discipline words. Edit here, never a tuple in code. A kind the code can decide that has no row here is a test failure. A kind decided with no row, or `none`, asks nothing and says so. `scored`: true only for a kind whose review was scored against an answer key (datasheet); no other kind goes live until it is (owner, 12 Nov, STATE 24). The engine choice and approvals read it.
page_strategy_rule: Deterministic split: pages are taken in page order; the whole paper goes in ONE window when its estimated tokens (characters / 4 + 20 per page) fit window_tokens; otherwise windows of consecutive pages, each as large as fits, the next one starting overlap_pages pages back. No page is ever skipped; the same paper always gives the same windows.

contract.checklist_slot: empty: the clause checklist is an engineer's job (not written)
contract.label: Contract

calculation.checklist_slot: none yet: a calculation is no longer asked datasheet rules; its own review (rules of kind calculation, a calculation checklist from an engineer) is not built
calculation.label: Calculation

transmittal.checklist_slot: none: a code-only list (documents listed against documents held; no AI call)
transmittal.label: Transmittal

unknown.checklist_slot: none: the engineer names the kind first
unknown.label: Unknown
